sloka: चर्म च अस्थि च मे राजन् न स्पृशन्ति मनीषिणः ।अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि सो अहम् पंच नखो हतः ॥४-१७-४०॥
transliteration: carma ca asthi ca me rājan na spṛśanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।abhakṣyāṇi ca māṁsāni so aham paṁca nakho hataḥ ॥4-17-40॥

translations.english: 'Tara knew everything. Her words were correct. They were meant for my wellbeing. However, due to my ignorance (or arrogance), I did not heed her words and fell under the sway of the lord of death
